k:HH.UI.Tab.GuideTip: Show or hide the little lesson panel at the top right.
k:HH.UI.Settings.ThisSaveTip: Edit the settings of the running colony. They are saved with it.
k:HH.UI.Settings.TemplateTip: Edit the template that new colonies start from. The running colony is not changed.
k:HH.UI.Settings.TemplateOnly: Template for new games. Each new colony gets its own copy.
k:HH.UI.Settings.EditingTemplate: Editing the template for new games. The running colony is not changed.
k:HH.UI.Settings.SaveAsTemplateTip: Copies modules, difficulty and all settings of this colony into the template for new games.
k:HH.UI.Settings.SaveAsTemplateConfirm: Replace the template for new games with the settings of this colony?
k:HH.UI.Settings.ApplyTemplateTip: Replaces the settings of this colony with the template.
k:HH.UI.Settings.ApplyTemplateConfirm: Replace modules, difficulty and all settings of this colony with the template? This cannot be undone.
k:HH.UI.Settings.NoMatch: No setting matches. Nerd settings are hidden unless you switch them on.
k:HH.UI.Settings.NerdTip: Shows the settings meant for people who like numbers. Everything else is unchanged.
k:HH.UI.Settings.ResetModuleConfirm: Reset every setting of {0} to its default?
k:HH.UI.Settings.ModuleIsOff: This module is switched off for this colony. Its settings have no effect.
k:HH.UI.Row.FreeTip: Free entry: type any number up to the technical limit of the game.
k:HH.UI.Row.Beyond: Beyond the slider range. Free entry allows this.
k:HH.UI.Row.LimitGeneric: The game cannot use this value, so the nearest possible one is used.
k:HH.UI.Row.FollowsTier: The default follows the hosting difficulty.
k:HH.UI.General.ShowCard: Show the first-start card in every new game
k:HH.UI.General.ShowCardTip: Off: new games quietly use the template and no card appears.
k:HH.UI.Modules.IntroSave: Modules can be switched per colony. A module that is off has no visible effect at all.
k:HH.UI.Modules.IntroTemplate: Modules for new colonies. Each colony can still change its own.
k:HH.UI.Modules.BankHint: Bank: use the bank inside Hearth & Harbor and switch all guest modules off. You do not need the standalone entry.
k:HH.UI.Modules.ContentDesc: How dark the optional content may get. Never sexual content, whatever you pick.
k:HH.UI.Content.Standard.Tip: The default. Rough edges, nothing nasty.
k:HH.UI.Content.Dark.Tip: Crime, debts and violence may show up.
k:HH.UI.Content.Grim.Tip: Everything the game offers, in full.
k:HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Inn: Guests, guest beds, wings, reception, travellers and recruiting.
k:HH.UI.ModuleDesc.ShopsFood: Venue signs, shops, vending, markets, restaurants and dishes.
k:HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Casino: Tables, slot machines, chips and the risks of gambling for guests and colonists.
k:HH.UI.ModuleDesc.CityLife: Cinema, mall, salon, temples, taxis and security.
k:HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Underworld: A discreet back room, a fight pit and a fence. Found in game, never forced.
k:HH.UI.ModuleDesc.Bank: Silverline: accounts, payments, ATMs, investments, loans, insurance and lottery.
k:HH.UI.ModuleDesc.AiFlavour: Optional flavour texts written by an AI through a relay. Off by default.
k:HH.UI.Diff.Title: Hosting difficulty
k:HH.UI.Diff.Calculator: What this tier means for you
k:HH.UI.Diff.ShowAll: Show all {0} values that follow the difficulty
k:HH.UI.Diff.WarnHard: From Overbooked on, real consequences are switched on: fines, licence loss and worse.
k:HH.UI.Diff.WarnEasy: This tier is very forgiving. Money comes easy and nothing goes wrong.
k:HH.UI.Diff.WarnBreaks: This breaks the game balance. On purpose?
k:HH.UI.Calc.SetByYou: You changed this value yourself, so it does not follow the slider.
k:HH.UI.Calc.NoEffectInfinite: No effect while Infinite guest money is on.
k:HH.UI.Feel.1: Money flows and nothing goes wrong.
k:HH.UI.Feel.3: Small losses are possible. Profit takes work.
k:HH.UI.Feel.4: Consequences switch on: quarrels, fines, licence loss.
k:HH.UI.Feel.5: Feuds, contracts, strict inspectors, revenge raids.
k:HH.UI.Feel.6: Everything is hard and nothing is capped.
k:HH.UI.Calc.guestMoney.Desc: Multiplies what guests carry and are willing to spend.
k:HH.UI.Calc.priceTolerance.Desc: How far above a fair price guests still buy.
k:HH.UI.Calc.expectation.Desc: Added to what every guest expects. Higher is harder to satisfy.
k:HH.UI.Calc.trouble.Desc: Chance and weight of quarrels, fights and thefts among guests.
k:HH.UI.Calc.stage.Desc: The worst thing a bad stay can do to you at this tier.
k:HH.UI.Calc.slotEdge.Desc: Share of every bet a slot machine keeps on average.
k:HH.UI.Calc.bankM.Desc: Yearly multiplier of the Silverline market. 1.2 means plus twenty percent.
k:HH.UI.Calc.defaultFactor.Desc: How often customers fail to pay what they owe.
k:HH.UI.Calc.collectionStage.Desc: How rough debt collection can get when you owe money.
k:HH.UI.Calc.researchCost.Desc: Multiplies the cost of Hearth & Harbor and Silverline research.
k:HH.UI.Calc.upkeep.Desc: Multiplies the running costs of your venues and rooms.
k:HH.UI.Calc.insuranceLoading.Desc: The insurer's markup on top of a fair premium.
k:HH.UI.Calc.salesPressure.Desc: How pushy the insurer's sales tricks get.
k:HH.UI.Calc.addiction.Desc: Base chance that a colonist who gambles a lot becomes addicted.
k:HH.UI.Calc.detection.Desc: How quickly cheating at a table is noticed.
k:HH.UI.Ladder.Goodwill.Desc: The most goodwill one faction can take away from you per incident.
k:HH.UI.Ladder.Renown.Desc: The most renown one incident can cost you.
k:HH.UI.Ladder.Fine.Desc: The most a single inspection or incident can fine you.
k:HH.UI.Ladder.Raids.Desc: Whether angry factions or mercenaries may come after you.
k:HH.UI.Ladder.Footer: Higher tiers unlock more consequences instead of just raising the odds.
k:HH.UI.Diag.PrepareRemovalTip: Gets the colony ready for taking the mod out: guests go home, open accounts are settled, special items are cleaned up.
k:HH.UI.Diag.PrepareRemovalConfirm: Prepare this colony for removing Hearth & Harbor? Guests are sent home and accounts are settled. Save a backup first.
k:HH.UI.Diag.RemovalDone: Done. Save the game, then remove the mod.
k:HH.UI.Diag.NeedsSave: Open a colony first. Preparing removal works on a running game.
k:HH.UI.Diag.Summary: {0} settings registered · {1} warnings · {2} errors in the log
k:HH.UI.About.Body: Hearth & Harbor turns your colony into a host: guests, inns and hotels, shops and restaurants, a casino, a spa, city life, a discreet back room and Silverline, a full bank. Nothing is forced on you. Until you mark a guest bed or put up a sign, the game plays like vanilla.
k:HH.UI.About.PartsBody: Silverline bank included: {0}. Guest modules included: {1}.
k:HH.UI.Card.Title: Welcome to Hearth & Harbor
k:HH.UI.Card.Sub: Pick your hosting style. Everything can be changed later in the mod settings.
